title: Reasoner Output
description: Structured clinical reasoning generated from image + observation + ground-truth label.

observation.description: Visual observation from Stage 1 Observer (passed through)

morphology.description: Refined morphology assessment connecting features to diagnosis

color.description: Refined color assessment connecting features to diagnosis

texture.description: Refined texture assessment connecting features to diagnosis

border.description: Refined border assessment connecting features to diagnosis

clinical_reasoning.description: 2-4 sentences connecting the visual observations to the diagnosis. Explain WHY these features support this specific condition.

differentials.description: Top 2-4 differential diagnoses with contrastive reasoning

confidence.description: Confidence that the visual features support the given diagnosis

label_match.description: Audit-only: reasoner's honest opinion whether the image actually shows the label. Does NOT affect training data — all entries are trained on regardless of this flag.

label_match_reason.description: Audit-only: reasoner's explanation when label_match=false. Empty string otherwise.
